description: What changed in a library or SDK since a date: every version published since then (npm, PyPI, crates, Go) and the release notes from its GitHub releases or CHANGELOG, newest first, with breaking-looking lines flagged. Works for any GitHub repository too (API SDKs, CLIs). Price: $0.005 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). In the free trial.

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem: npm, pypi, crates (Rust) or go (Go modules).

repo.description: Or: a GitHub repository, owner/name or URL.

since.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO time) to report changes after, up to 2 years back.

name: changelog

changed.description: True if anything was published after `since`.

releases.description: Release notes since the date, newest first.

versions.description: Package versions published since the date (registry).

title: Changelog ($0.005)
